# Q3 2026 Business Report — Executive Team
        
        ## Travel Cancellation Policy
        
        *Current as of Q3 2026*
        
        ---
        
        ### 1. Flight Booking Cancellations
        
        | Cancellation Window | Refund | Penalty |
        |---|---|---|
        | **24 + hours** before departure | Full refund of the base fare | No penalty |
        | **Less than 24 hours** before departure | No refund | Full fare forfeited |
        | **No-show** | No refund | Full fare forfeited |
        
        - Cancellation requests must be made through customer service or the online portal.
        - Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days to the original payment method.
        
        ---
        
        ### 2. Hotel Reservation Cancellations
        
        | Cancellation Window | Refund | Penalty |
        |---|---|---|
        | **24 + hours** before check-in | Full refund | No penalty |
        | **Less than 24 hours** before check-in | Charged for the first night | Remaining nights refunded |
        | **No-show** | No refund | Full reservation cost forfeited |
        
        - Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days.
        - Some promotional or discounted rates may be non-refundable regardless of timing.
        
        ---
        
        ### 3. Car Rental Cancellations
        
        | Cancellation Window | Refund | Penalty |
        |---|---|---|
        | **48 + hours** before pickup | Full refund | No penalty |
        | **24 – 48 hours** before pickup | 50% refund | 50% of rental cost forfeited |
        | **Less than 24 hours** before pickup | No refund | Full rental cost forfeited |
        
        - Refunds are processed within 5–7 business days.
        - Fuel and insurance charges are non-refundable once the rental period has started.
        
        ---
        
        ### 4. Modification (Change) Policy
        
        - Reservation changes are permitted up to **24 hours before the scheduled start** (departure, check-in, or pickup).
        - Changes may incur a fare or rate difference if the new option costs more.
        - Only **one free change** is allowed per reservation; subsequent changes may incur a processing fee.
        - Changes within 24 hours of the scheduled start are treated as a cancellation and rebooking, subject to the cancellation policy above.
        
        ---
        
        ### Summary
        
        | Reservation Type | Full Refund Window | Partial Refund Window | No Refund |
        |---|---|---|---|
        | Flight Booking | 24 h+ before departure | — | < 24 h / No-show |
        | Hotel Reservation | 24 h+ before check-in | < 24 h (first night charged) | No-show |
        | Car Rental | 48 h+ before pickup | 24–48 h (50% refund) | < 24 h |
        
        > **Note:** All refunds are processed within 5–7 business days to the original payment method. Promotional or discounted rates may be non-refundable. Fuel and insurance charges on car rentals are non-refundable once the rental period has started.
        
        ---
        
        *Prepared for the Executive Team — Q3 2026*

# Q3 2026 Business Report — Executive Team
        
        ## Travel Cancellation Policy
        
        *Current as of Q3 2026*
        
        ---
        
        ### 1. Flight Booking Cancellations
        
        **Free Cancellation Window:**
        - Domestic flights: Full refund within **24 hours** of booking
        - International flights: Full refund within **48 hours** of booking
        
        **After Free Window — Cancellation Fees by Cabin Class:**
        
        | Cabin Class | Route Type | Cancellation Fee |
        |---|---|---|
        | Basic Economy | Any | Not cancellable (unless travel insurance purchased) |
        | Economy | Domestic | max($50, 15% of ticket price) |
        | Economy | International | max($75, 20% of ticket price) |
        | Business | Domestic | 5% of ticket price |
        | Business | International | 8% of ticket price |
        | First | Any | Free cancellation |
        
        - Travel insurance covers cancellation regardless of cabin class.
        - Fees differ by route type (domestic vs. international).
        
        ---
        
        ### 2. Hotel Reservation Cancellations
        
        | Cancellation Window | Standard Room | Suite |
        |---|---|---|
        | **48+ hours** before check-in | Free cancellation | Non-refundable (full charge) |
        | **24–48 hours** before check-in | 50% of first night charge | Non-refundable (full charge) |
        | **Less than 24 hours** before check-in | Full first night charge | Non-refundable (full charge) |
        
        - Suite bookings are non-refundable regardless of cancellation timing.
        
        ---
        
        ### 3. Car Rental Cancellations
        
        | Cancellation Window | Refund | Penalty |
        |---|---|---|
        | **24+ hours** before pickup | Full refund | No penalty |
        | **Less than 24 hours** before pickup | Partial — one day charge deducted | One day rental charge |
        
        - **Luxury & SUV surcharge:** Luxury and SUV rentals incur an additional **$50 cancellation surcharge** at all times, regardless of cancellation window.
        
        ---
        
        ### 4. Modification (Change) Policy
        
        **Free Change Window:**
        - Domestic: Free changes within **24 hours** of booking
        - International: Free changes within **48 hours** of booking
        
        **After Free Window — Change Fees (Economy Class):**
        
        | Route Type | Departure > 7 Days Away | Departure ≤ 7 Days Away |
        |---|---|---|
        | Domestic (personal) | $75 + fare difference | $150 + fare difference |
        | International (personal) | $100 + fare difference | $200 + fare difference |
        
        **Special Circumstances (Economy):**

        |---|---|

        | Bereavement | 75% discount on standard fee (rounded down to nearest dollar) |
        | Jury Duty | Free change |
        | Military Deployment | Free change |
        | Airline Schedule Change | Free change |
        | Weather | Free change |
        
        - **Basic Economy:** Not changeable after the free window.
        - **Business & First Class:** Free changes (fare difference still applies).
        
        ---
        
        ### Summary
        
        | Reservation Type | Full Refund Window | Partial Refund / Fee | No Refund |
        |---|---|---|---|
        | Flight Booking | 24 h (domestic) / 48 h (international) from booking | Fee by cabin class & route | Basic Economy (uninsured) |
